cohorts.summary: Early players praise handheld performance while highlighting complaints about linear design, repetitive fights, and puzzles.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the combat as repetitive and boring, citing a lack of variety and recycled boss encounters.

citations.review_text: Unfortunetely, 90% of the game is boring, repetitive fight and completely uninteresting environment puzzles. The remaining 10% are pretty good cutscenes, but I won't waste my time to reach tem. I have no idea how this could have won Game Awards' GOTY instead of Red Dead Redemption 2.

This is the most overrated game I have ever played. It did not deserve GOTY. It is extremely linear and repetitive, the story is the only thing "decent". The combat isn't anything extraordinary, the enemies you fight all feel the same; they reuse the same troll boss the entire game (reskinned), this boss genuinely just isn't fun to fight which is the biggest problem. The whole game you just walk in a straight line, do some puzzles, some enemies jump you and you just keep walking and repeat this cycle until every now and then there is a mediocre boss or some cutscenes. I get that every game has a gameplay loop, but this loop is just boring. If you like overly linear games with hand holding and boring puzzles this is the game for you, if not, don't waste your money.

Story, world, gameplay.. nothing even close to the old God Of War! If you expect something so good like the real GOW like i did, just dont buy it lol
It's literally generic assets, generic same boss's style, boring missions, and a really really wack story bro. 
IF YOU WANT TO BE A DAD FOR A COUPLE HOURS PLAY THIS xD

[b]It’s a bad game[/b]
It’s practically a walking simulator, where you occasionally press B on your gamepad to squeeze through a hole or climb a rock.

It has no substance to it, just a story and endless talking. The combat is boring, because you have: light attack, heavy attack, a shield and a kid with a bow. That’s it, there is nothing more to that. Combos don’t do anything because you still press the same 3 buttons, they just do a slightly different thing now.

Story is garbage. “I want to leave this place” is the whole motivation of this journey. No adventure, no exploration, no thrill, just “I want to leave this place”. You know Sony, I want to leave this game! Characters have no chemistry, they don’t care about anything, even about each other. They are talking objects, that are meant to fill the silence.

Soundtrack. I didn’t notice anything. There is no soundtrack. I didn’t hear anything other than endless yapping and screaming.

Graphics in this game is so bland and lacks style, that some people may mistake it for Horizon: Zero Dawn, because they look the exact same. The same ultra-realistic style from every recent Sony game, that are meant to make their games “cinematic”. Games used to be games, not movies. Constant camera and controller overtaking because you know, “cinema”. It constantly breaks its pace.

Locations are literally straight lines that lead you to a circular room with something in them, like an enemy or loot. That’s the whole story, no exploration, no world to travel - just straight lines leading to circular rooms.

I can’t recommend this garbage of a game. If you want an interesting slasher - play Dark Souls 3 (or even Devil May Cry 5, because playing as Vergil is really fun), it’s a masterpiece. If you want to play a story game - Resident Evil series is a great choice. This game offers nothing, but every modern game sins.

single_points.text: One reviewer says the equipment and upgrade systems can be a little confusing at first.

citation.review_text:
God of War (2018) is an amazing game! This was my first time playing it, and I really enjoyed the experience. Having played God of War 1, 2, 3, and spin-offs like Ghost of Sparta and Chains of Olympus, the familiar mechanics made it easier to get into the game.

I recently played God of War 3 and absolutely loved it, so I had to try this one too. The gameplay is solid, although the equipment and upgrade systems can be a little confusing at first. I'm still learning how everything works. Collecting all the chests also requires some effort.

Overall, it's an incredible game. Being able to play a PlayStation exclusive on PC is a huge plus. Honestly, this is one of the best games I've played, and it absolutely deserves its Game of the Year award!

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features a limited variety of enemies, leading to repetitive encounters and repeated fights against similar boss types such as trolls.

citations.review_text: The game had an amazing story, showing the growth of atreus and Kratos's relationship, and then going into the new Norse mythology aspects of the game, and Mimir gives you great explanations on a lot of the myths or backstories of most characters. The combat itself was pretty fun overall, and the blades are super fun to use. The only problem i have is that the boss fights are very repetitive, you just fight a bunch of trolls and then  you have the final boss fight, but overall it was a really good game.

God of War (2018) is easily one of the best games I've ever played. Everything from the story to the combat is just incredible. I love how they took Kratos, a character who was basically fueled by nothing but rage in the older games, and gave him so much more depth without taking away what made him such a badass in the first place.

The combat feels amazing, especially once you start unlocking more abilities and getting comfortable with the Leviathan Axe. Throwing that thing and calling it back never gets old. The boss fights are great, the environments look beautiful, and the soundtrack makes some of those moments hit even harder.

What really makes this game stand out to me is the relationship between Kratos and Atreus. Watching their relationship develop throughout the story is something I didn't expect to enjoy as much as I did. The writing is genuinely good, and the characters actually feel like they have something worth fighting for.

My only real complaint is that I wish there was a little more variety with some of the enemies and bosses. Other than that, I really don't have much to complain about.

If you've never played God of War, you're seriously missing out. Even if you've never touched the older games, this is absolutely worth playing. It's one of those games that reminds me why I love gaming so much.

**9.5/10. Absolutely worth your time.**

Great game! I really enjoyed the story and combat mechanics. The open world is a nice balance between being large enough and not feeling overwhelming. The main downside is the lack of enemy variety, as you end up fighting the same mobs over and over again, with the Valkyries being an exception.

Platinum this game with 100% all collectibles, but there are some major issues in this game...

Starting with the good part, the story between kratos and aterus on their path to the mountain is well-written. The kid was naive and insists to prove himself worthy to father, as the story progress you can see the personal growth on this character. And imo this have already sum out the good things in this game.

Now as story progress, you get to explore the Midgard areas and accept side quests, this is where the downside starting to make apparent. The puzzle solving is straight-up boring and time consuming, most of the bell thingy just hide it very deep without any ingenuity, whoever has a better eyesight to spot it. Raven and treasure map collectible also a waste of time, the path at the island is either one-way only or have a lot of insivible wall blocking. I stucked at a open space before that apparently can be jump down but it won't allow for 20 minutes finding the exit point, the map direction is so terible. What is the point of equipment upgrade if enemies are adjusted accordingly to your gear & weapon level up? There are a lot of equipment in this game but most of it I just neglect it after getting into my inverntory. Most of the time you would just out of the hacksliver and materials required to upgrade the gear without doing any side quests.

Post-game content, troll enemies and other small grunt type is just basically reskin and reuse. The witch or AKA revenant is so annoying to go against, same as the dark elves that will block or fly away when trying to attack them. Bind it to nilfheim & muspelheim, if you want to experience how someone feeds you with expired food to disgust you this is it.
